guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Active support of telescope primary mirrors
guides.concept: 以 VLT 8.2 m、175 mm 厚的 Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡與 150 支軸向致動器為主軸，理解為什麼薄鏡必須由力分佈定義面形，再把彎曲模態、仰角載重、溫度梯度、30 秒積分的 Shack–Hartmann 感測、查找表與力圖健康監測整合成可驗收的主動光學工程。
guides.conceptEn: Built around the VLT's 8.2 m, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus and its 150 axial actuators, this course shows why a thin mirror's figure must be defined by its force distribution, then integrates bending modes, elevation loads, thermal gradients, 30-second Shack–Hartmann sensing, look-up tables and force-map health monitoring into an acceptable active-optics engineering record.
procedure: 傳統主鏡以約 1:6 的厚徑比維持剛性，但口徑放大到 8 m 時鏡坯會重達上百噸、熱時間常數長達數天，鏡室與望遠鏡結構都難以承受。VLT 改用直徑 8.2 m、厚 175 mm 的 Zerodur 薄彎月鏡，厚徑比約 1:47、質量約 23 噸；然而板的彎曲剛度 D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) 隨厚度三次方下降，鏡面在自身重量下已無法保持形狀。主動支撐的出發點就是承認這面鏡子是軟的，改由支撐力的分佈來定義面形。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主動光學以約每分鐘一次的節奏修正緩慢變化的像差，包括隨仰角改變的重力變形、溫度梯度、拋光殘差與支撐誤差，而不是修正大氣湍流。把鏡面變形展開成自由圓板的彎曲模態最有效率，因為每個模態有各自的剛性：像散與三葉形等低階模態最軟，只需小力就能修正，高階模態所需的力則隨階數迅速增加。因此主動光學只修前十到二十個模態，更高階的誤差必須在拋光階段就做好；VLT 另把離焦與彗差交給副鏡的位置修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

VLT 主鏡由 150 支電腦控制的軸向力致動器支撐，每支透過三腳架與 invar 墊（共 450 個）把力分散到鏡背，避免點載重在鏡面留下印痕。致動器同時承擔被動重量並疊加主動修正力，所以設計重點是力控制而非位置控制：鏡子的剛體位置由少數定義點或分區的被動系統決定，其餘致動器負責在該位置下提供正確的力分佈。仰角改變時軸向分量按 cos z 減少，力設定點必須連續追隨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「150 支軸向致動器與荷重元」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

望遠鏡傾斜時，鏡重的 sin z 分量由黏在鏡緣的側向支撐墊承擔；側向力若不通過鏡子的質心平面就會產生彎矩，把像散壓進鏡面，因此側向支撐的位置與力分配必須與軸向力修正搭配設計。溫度則有兩種效應：穿過厚度的溫度梯度使鏡面整體彎曲，主要表現為離焦；Zerodur 熱膨脹係數的不均勻則在整體溫變下產生高階變形。此外鏡面比夜間空氣暖時會在表面形成湍流邊界層，所以白天要把鏡子預冷到預期的夜間溫度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「側向支撐與鏡室熱環境」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主動光學的波前感測器裝在導引探頭中，以視場邊緣的一顆星做 Shack–Hartmann 量測：微透鏡陣列把瞳面切成子孔徑，每個光點的位移正比於該處的局部波前斜率。因為要量的是鏡面而不是大氣，曝光必須長到把湍流造成的光點隨機抖動平均掉，VLT 以約 30 秒積分、約每分鐘修正一次。量到的斜率再以最小平方法投影到主鏡彎曲模態與副鏡的離焦、彗差，換算成力與位置修正量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Shack–Hartmann 主動光學感測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主動光學的核心校正是影響矩陣，也就是每一支致動器或每一組模態力分佈對波前感測量測值的響應。控制器用矩陣的擬反把量到的模態係數轉成力修正，並截斷奇異值太小的模態，以免把雜訊放大。修正後的殘差要進入誤差預算：拋光殘差、支撐印痕、主動光學殘差、熱變形與風載各項以均方根相加，再換算成不同波長的 Strehl 或影像寬度，才能判斷主鏡是否滿足儀器需求。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「影響矩陣與誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每次換目標都沒有時間從零收斂，所以主動光學以開迴路查找表為基礎：依鏡筒仰角與溫度預測主鏡力分佈與副鏡位置，再用閉迴路量測逐步修正殘差。主鏡負責像散、三葉形、球差等彎曲模態，副鏡以位置移動修正離焦與彗差，兩者共用同一組感測資料但頻寬不同；VLT 另有最高約 1 Hz 的快速修正，只處理最低階項。查找表的品質決定了換目標後多久才能開始科學曝光。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「仰角查找表與副鏡六軸平台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主動支撐的驗收必須在望遠鏡上完成：在各仰角與溫度條件下量閉迴路後的模態殘差與影像寬度，把主鏡對總影像品質的貢獻從大氣、導星與儀器中分離出來。運轉後，力圖是主鏡健康最直接的紀錄：每支致動器的力歷史、力總和與重量的一致性、主動力是否逐漸逼近極限，都能提前揭露卡滯、荷重元漂移或支撐墊脫膠。交接文件需包含影響矩陣版本、查找表、各致動器校正係數與安全限值。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「影像品質驗收與力圖監測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Classical primaries keep their stiffness with a thickness-to-diameter ratio near 1:6, but at 8 m aperture such a blank would weigh well over a hundred tonnes with a thermal time constant of days, burdening both cell and telescope structure. The VLT instead uses an 8.2 m diameter, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus with an aspect ratio near 1:47 and a mass of about 23 tonnes; however the plate bending stiffness D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) falls with the cube of thickness, so the mirror can no longer hold its shape under its own weight. Active support starts by accepting that the mirror is soft and letting the distribution of support forces define its figure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “8.2 m thin meniscus blank”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Active optics corrects slowly varying aberrations at roughly one update per minute, including elevation-dependent gravity deformation, thermal gradients, polishing residuals and support errors, not atmospheric turbulence. Expanding the deformation in the bending modes of a free circular plate is most efficient because each mode has its own stiffness: low-order modes such as astigmatism and trefoil are softest and need little force, while the force needed rises steeply with mode order. Active optics therefore corrects only the first ten to twenty modes, higher orders must be polished out, and the VLT hands defocus and coma to secondary-mirror position control. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bending modes and correction-force patterns”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The VLT primary rests on 150 computer-controlled axial force actuators, each spreading its load through a tripod and invar pads, 450 in total, so that point loads do not print through to the surface. The actuators carry the passive weight and add active correction forces on top, so the design emphasises force control rather than position control: the mirror's rigid-body position is fixed by a few defining points or passive zoned systems, and the remaining actuators supply the correct force distribution at that position. As elevation changes the axial component falls as cos z, and the force set points must follow continuously. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “150 axial actuators and load cells”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

When the telescope tilts, the sin z component of the weight is carried by lateral pads bonded to the mirror edge; lateral forces that do not act through the plane of the centre of mass create bending moments that press astigmatism into the surface, so lateral-support placement and force sharing must be designed together with axial corrections. Temperature acts in two ways: a gradient through the thickness bends the whole mirror, mainly as defocus, while inhomogeneity of the Zerodur expansion coefficient produces higher-order deformation under uniform temperature change. A mirror warmer than the night air also grows a turbulent boundary layer above its surface, so it is pre-cooled during the day to the expected night temperature. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lateral supports and cell thermal environment”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The active-optics wavefront sensor sits in the guide probe and makes a Shack–Hartmann measurement on a star at the edge of the field: a lenslet array divides the pupil into subapertures, and each spot's displacement is proportional to the local wavefront slope. Because the target is the mirror and not the atmosphere, exposures must be long enough to average out turbulence-induced spot jitter, so the VLT integrates for about 30 s and corrects roughly once a minute. The measured slopes are projected by least squares onto the primary's bending modes and the secondary's defocus and coma, then converted into force and position corrections. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active-optics Shack–Hartmann sensor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The central calibration of active optics is the influence matrix, the response of the wavefront-sensor measurements to each actuator or each modal force pattern. The controller uses its pseudo-inverse to turn measured mode coefficients into force corrections, truncating modes with small singular values so that noise is not amplified. The corrected residual then enters the error budget: polishing residual, support print-through, active-optics residual, thermal deformation and wind load are added root-sum-square and converted into Strehl or image width at several wavelengths to judge whether the primary meets instrument needs. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Influence matrix and error-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

There is no time to converge from scratch after every slew, so active optics starts from open-loop look-up tables that predict primary forces and secondary position from tube elevation and temperature, and then trims the residual with closed-loop measurements. The primary handles bending modes such as astigmatism, trefoil and spherical aberration, while the secondary corrects defocus and coma by moving, both sharing the same sensor data at different bandwidths; the VLT also runs fast corrections up to about 1 Hz for the lowest-order terms only. Table quality decides how soon after a slew science exposures can start. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Elevation look-up table and M2 hexapod”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance of active support must happen on the telescope: measure closed-loop mode residuals and image width over elevation and temperature, separating the primary's contribution to total image quality from atmosphere, guide star and instrument. In operation the force map is the most direct record of mirror health: each actuator's force history, the agreement of the force sum with the weight, and whether active forces creep towards their limits all reveal sticking, load-cell drift or debonding pads early. The handoff file must hold the influence-matrix version, look-up tables, per-actuator calibration coefficients and safety limits. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Image-quality acceptance and force-map monitoring”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若把薄鏡當成剛體，只用少數硬點支撐或夾持，鏡面在重力下產生毫米級變形與強烈像散，影像完全失焦；即使支撐點數足夠，只要某一區的力分配錯誤，該區就會留下數百 nm 的局部凹陷。
若積分只有幾秒，殘留的大氣像差被當成鏡面誤差送進致動器，主鏡每次修正都在追隨機雜訊，面形越修越差；參考零點若隨溫度漂移，則會穩定地把一個不存在的像差寫進鏡面。
pitfallsEn: Treating the thin mirror as rigid and holding it on a few hard points or clamps produces millimetre-scale gravity deformation and severe astigmatism, defocusing the image entirely; even with enough supports, a wrong force allocation in one zone leaves a local depression of hundreds of nanometres there.

With only a few seconds of integration, residual atmospheric aberration is mistaken for mirror error and sent to the actuators, so each correction chases random noise and the figure degrades; a reference zero point that drifts with temperature steadily writes a non-existent aberration into the mirror.

related.title: 分段鏡共相控制
related.transfer: 可遷移「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」與「波前感測：積分時間、視寧度平均與模態估計」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；分段鏡共相控制的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus" and "Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Segmented-mirror co-phasing control must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦薄彎月主鏡的重力變形、模態剛性、軸向與側向支撐、低頻波前感測與力圖監測；分段鏡共相控制則以段鏡 piston 誤差的光學代價、邊緣感測器與致動器、2π 模糊、共相相機、設定點校正與段鏡更換為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on gravity sag of thin meniscus primaries, modal stiffness, axial and lateral support, low-rate wavefront sensing and force-map monitoring; Segmented-mirror co-phasing control centres on optical cost of segment piston, edge sensors and actuators, 2π ambiguity, phasing cameras, set-point calibration and segment exchange, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」與「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到分段鏡共相控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「感測器設定點校正與共相誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “8.2 m thin meniscus blank” and “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Segmented-mirror co-phasing control, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Sensor set-point calibration and the phasing error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 天文自適應光學
related.transfer: 可遷移「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」與「波前感測：積分時間、視寧度平均與模態估計」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；天文自適應光學的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus" and "Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Astronomical adaptive optics must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦薄彎月主鏡的重力變形、模態剛性、軸向與側向支撐、低頻波前感測與力圖監測；天文自適應光學則以從 Fried 參數到 Strehl 預算的 VLT／ELT 自適應光學工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on gravity sag of thin meniscus primaries, modal stiffness, axial and lateral support, low-rate wavefront sensing and force-map monitoring; Astronomical adaptive optics centres on VLT and ELT adaptive-optics engineering from the Fried parameter to the Strehl budget, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」與「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到天文自適應光學，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「誤差預算與 Strehl 比」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “8.2 m thin meniscus blank” and “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Astronomical adaptive optics, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Error budget and the Strehl ratio", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐
history.titleEn: Active support of telescope primary mirrors
history.text: 主動光學由 ESO 的 Raymond Wilson 在 1970 至 1980 年代系統化提出，1989 年拉西亞的 3.58 m 新技術望遠鏡（NTT）成為第一座以主動光學運轉的大型望遠鏡，證明薄而軟的主鏡可以由電腦控制的支撐力保持面形。1998 年起 VLT 的四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡沿用此概念，Gemini 與 Subaru 的 8 m 級彎月鏡也各自採用主動支撐，使 8 m 級單片主鏡成為可行。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Active optics was systematised by Raymond Wilson at ESO during the 1970s and 1980s, and in 1989 the 3.58 m New Technology Telescope (NTT) at La Silla became the first large telescope operated with active optics, proving that a thin, flexible primary can hold its figure through computer-controlled support forces. From 1998 the four 8.2 m VLT Unit Telescopes adopted the concept, and the 8 m class menisci of Gemini and Subaru also use active support, making monolithic 8 m primaries feasible. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」到「整合驗證、力圖監測與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus" through "Integrated validation, force-map monitoring and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
